rules.text: Destination shelters must not be exposed to flooding; keep the destination flood severity below 0.60 at arrival.

evidence.span: To avoid ﬂooding, the temporary shelters should not be built in the low-lying areas.

rules.draft_note: Source is qualitative; the 0.60 / 0.45 thresholds are a modelling proposal for the approver.

rules.text: Shelters should keep room for safety, security, comfort and privacy; keep projected occupancy (including the arriving group) at or below 90 percent of capacity.

evidence.span: Shelters should ensure safety, security, comfort and privacy for all.

rules.draft_note: Source is qualitative; the 0.90 / 0.80 thresholds are a modelling proposal for the approver.

rules.text: Evacuation must not add injury risk; avoid routes whose edge flood hazard at entry exceeds 0.60.

evidence.span: Temporary shelters should be disaster resistant and not cause any further injury or loss of life.

rules.draft_note: Weak support: the sentence is about shelters, not routes. Recommend rejecting unless the approver agrees; thresholds are a modelling proposal.
